piadas: Why does the backpack never go to parties? Because it is always loaded.
Why did the compass break up with the map? It felt it was always being told where to go.
What did the campfire say to the log? You light up my life.
Why do survivalists love knots? Because they never leave anything hanging.
Why did the flashlight get promoted? It was always the brightest in the room.
Why don't tents ever get lonely? They always have a few friends staking them down.
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
Why was the water bottle so calm? It knew how to keep its cool.
Why did the radio feel confident? It was always on the right wavelength.
Why did the hiker bring a ladder? To reach new heights.
Why did the rope go to school? To learn how to tie things together.
Why did the tent go to therapy? It had too many issues with its poles.
Why did the matchbox lose the argument? It got too heated.
Why do fish never get lost? They always follow the current.
Why don't skeletons go hiking? They don't have the guts.
Why did the map get an award? It always found its way.
Why did the first aid kit blush? It saw the bandage dressing.
What kind of tree fits in your hand? A palm tree.
Why did the survival manual never panic? It always had a plan.

why.offline: Since we are **offline**, I can only use what is stored on your phone.

why.mode: **Local knowledge base** mode is on (AI Mode in the ≡ menu), so I am only using the files on your phone.

Rest is part of survival too. Have you managed to take a break today?
That happens to the best of us. A glass of water and ten minutes off the screen work wonders.
Then let's keep things simple today. Is there anything quick I can help with?
